title: Base case of the circuit-to-decision-tree reduction (depth 2)
statement:
Let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ be a Boolean function on $n\ge 1$ variables, let $s,w,l\ge 1$ be positive integers, let $t\ge 0$, and suppose $f$ is computed by a Boolean circuit of depth at most $2$, size at most $s$, and fan-in at most $w$. Draw a random restriction $\rho$ that leaves each variable free independently with probability $p=\tfrac{1}{40w}$ and otherwise fixes it to $0$ or $1$, each with probability $\tfrac{1-p}{2}$. Writing $D(g)$ for the least depth of a decision tree computing a Boolean function $g$, and $f\!\restriction_\rho$ for the function obtained from $f$ by substituting the fixed values of $\rho$ and keeping the free coordinates as inputs, the probability that the restricted function is hard to compute by a shallow decision tree satisfies
\[
  \Pr_{\rho}\!\big[\,D(f\!\restriction_\rho) > t\,\big]
  \le (s-1)\left(\tfrac12\right)^{l} + \left(\tfrac12\right)^{t}
     + (s-1)\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120w}\right) + s\,\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120l}\right).
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on n variables
f computed by a Boolean circuit of depth at most 2
that circuit has size at most s
that circuit has fan-in at most w
restriction drawn Bernoulli with parameter composedDelta(w,l,2) = 1/(40w)
replaced:
The base case ($d=2$) of the inductive bound: if $f$ is computed by a depth-$2$ circuit of
size at most $s$ and fan-in at most $w$ (with $s,w,l>0$ and $n>0$), then under the composed
restriction parameter $\mathrm{composedDelta}(w,l,2)$,
\[
  \Pr\!\left[\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\,f\,\rho) > t\right]
  \le (s-1)(1/2)^{l} + (1/2)^{t} + (s-1)\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120w}\right)
    + s\,\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120l}\right).
\]
